wiki.title: Addison McDowell
wiki.extract: Addison Parker McDowell (born January 21, 1994) is an American politician and lobbyist serving as the U.S. representative for North Carolina's 6th congressional district since 2025. A member of the Republican Party, McDowell was first elected in 2024.
